name: SOC Automation Lab - Detection Coverage
description: Coverage for the SOC Automation Lab. Dark green (score 100) = custom MITRE-mapped rule authored and validated by emulated attack. Light green (score 50) = worked in the analyst casebook using built-in Wazuh telemetry (FIM, rootcheck, web ruleset, auditd, VT integration). See detections/ and casebook/.

techniques.comment: Custom rules 100001/100002 (SSH brute force). Auto-contained via Wazuh firewall-drop. CASE-001, CASE-002.
Custom rules 100010/100011 (sudo abuse). Host action response. CASE-006.
Custom rule 100020 (local account created). Velociraptor confirms. CASE-003.
Windows rule - encoded PowerShell (PowerShell EID 4104). CASE-004 (pending endpoint).
Windows rule - scheduled task (Sysmon EID 1 / Security EID 4698).
Windows rule - LSASS access (Sysmon EID 10). CASE-005 (pending endpoint).
Successful / anomalous SSH login (built-in SSH ruleset). CASE-007, CASE-008.
Critical auth file modified - sshd_config (FIM/syscheck). CASE-009.
Web shell dropped in web root (FIM). CASE-010.
SQL injection attempt (Wazuh web ruleset). CASE-011.
Cron-based persistence (FIM on cron paths). CASE-013.
Reverse shell via Unix shell (auditd command monitoring). CASE-014.
Suspicious outbound connection / C2 channel. CASE-014.
Recon / dual-use tool installed (auditd / package monitoring). CASE-017.
Malicious file by hash reputation (Wazuh VirusTotal integration). CASE-018.
